offline.title: Display offline
offline.description: Cart details are hidden until the connection returns. No previous sale is shown as current.

noRegister.title: Open a register to begin
noRegister.description: Start a cash session on the sales screen, then keep that screen open while this display mirrors the cart.

waiting.title: Waiting for {{register}}
waiting.description: Keep the active sales screen open in another window. This display clears itself when the feed becomes stale.

idle.title: Ready for the next purchase
idle.description: Items and totals will appear here as the cashier builds the sale.

summary.checkoutHint: The cashier will confirm the final amount before payment.

privacy: This screen shows products and totals only. Customer, employee, payment and note details are never mirrored.
